candidate.title: Group name is stripped on create but not on update, allowing whitespace-padded names
reports: groupscontrollerupdate does not strip group.name (unlike create), so a name like " bob " can be saved via update, inconsistent with create and the username-style name rule

group-name normalization is enforced on create but not on update: creating strips params[:name] but the update path assigns group.name = params[:name] without stripping, so renaming an existing group to ' bob ' stores the whitespace-padded name, violating the no-spaces rule and breaking group-mention handling

inconsistent group-name normalization between create and update: create strips whitespace via (params[:name] || '').strip but update assigns group.name = params[:name] with no strip, so the same input ' bob ' is accepted on create but rejected or stored dirty on update; normalization belongs in one place such as the model (admin/groupscontroller.rb:24 vs :40)

[advisory] create strips the group name ((params[:name] || '').strip) but update does not (group.name = params[:name]), so the same value round-trips differently through the two endpoints. an admin who edits an existing group and submits a name with trailing whitespace bypasses the normalization create applies; the rename either fails validation with a confusing error or, if validation is whitespace-tolerant, leaves a group whose name differs from what the admin thinks they saved.
